posts.headline: Thicks' Klint's Clipboard climbed to 7-2 but the receipt is still bouncing — 1026.8 points-for barely cracks the top half of this league, ring or no ring.
posts.detail: Fifty-three editions of asking for proof and Tyrique14 keeps handing over a win total padded by matchups, not production — a 1-title, 5.5-avg-finish contender living dangerously close to its own hype.

posts.headline: Chauncey's talentedtenthh is drowning at 2-7 with a league-worst 934.22 points-for, and the untalented tenth bit writes itself every single week.
posts.detail: A career 4-10 record and a 12th-place average finish say this isn't a slump, it's a brand — talentedtenthh remains the most accurately named disaster in Busters Anonymous.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's Put it in Ra is still stuck at 2-7, and a 20-8 career record with a 1.5 average finish is now unrecognizable wreckage.
posts.detail: This is the best pedigree in the entire league on paper — two titles' worth of consistency — and yet adambarner111 is scraping 929.86 points-for, proof that even Cal Berkeley grads can't out-GPA a cratering roster.

posts.headline: Sasinci can't buy a win at 4-5, and Big Head's title defense is now officially a ghost story told to scare rookies.
posts.detail: A former champion sitting at 1026.66 points-for with a sub-.500 record is exactly the kind of fall from grace that makes a 1-title résumé feel like ancient history — Milk Man, start singing something else.

posts.headline: Peacemakers 🙏 quietly sit at 7-2 with 1241.36 points-for, and Bubble Guts is suddenly playing like he forgot his own worst moment ever happened.
posts.detail: A career 15-13 record and a best finish of 2nd made him a forgettable middle-tier guy, but this season's scoring output is forcing the league to ask if briangalvan1 finally cleaned up his act for good.
